decision: Selected the centroid of Garfield County parcel 0000-16-22N-06W-3-100-00 (the SW/4 of Section 16, T22N, R6W of the Indian Meridian, less a 183 by 187 ft excepted residence tract; 159 roll acres), the parcel named in the Enid MAPC agenda for the Project Thunderbird West Campus western-quarter rezoning (A to I-3), as the campus locator. It locates the rezoning tract, not a data-centre building, site plan or works.

identity_bridge: Application 2 (West Campus, Western Quarter), received by the City of Enid on 27 August 2026: SW/4 of Section 16, T22N, R6W, Garfield County, less a tract beginning at the SW corner running N 183 ft, E 187 ft, S 183 ft, W 187 ft; legal owner Two Boots Land and Cattle, LLC; applicant Plainsmen Holdings, LLC.

MAPC special meeting agenda of 28 September 2026 (posted 25 September), items 10-11: the same request 'to rezone the property with Parcel ID 0000-16-22N-06W-3-100-00' with the identical legal description.
The parcel's roll legal description repeats the application's exception exactly, and the excepted tract is the separate 1-acre parcel 0000-16-22N-06W-3-625-00 at the SW corner.

The applicant's area map (sheet 2 of 4) draws the subject property between S 16th St and S 30th St, north of E Rupe Ave, with the Application 3 I-2 tract (S/2 SE/4, parcel 0000-16-22N-06W-4-150-00) to the east; the parcel polygon spans lon -97.8548 to -97.8458 and lat 36.3762 to 36.3835, consistent with that quarter section.
alternatives_rejected: Parcel 0000-16-22N-06W-4-150-00 (SE/4 less Pioneer Trail Addition, 147 acres): its southern half is the I-2 transition tract, where the application and the MAPC plan amendment exclude any data center or generating facility.

North Campus parcels in Section 23, T23N, R6W (four parcels, 560 acres): a separate tract about 10 km north whose application lists electric generation, energy storage and data center among possible uses; held separately.
City or industrial-park centroids: not acceptable locators.
